probe.title: Mammoth Brands
probe.text_sample: Mammoth Brands Skip to content Home Home Careers News Create Things People Like More Our mission is to “Create Things People Like More.” Simply put: everything we do should be better than what already exists. If it’s not, we don’t do it. This guides everything we do, from developing the best product experiences, to making Mammoth Brands a great place to work, to exploring innovative ways to give back to our community. We’re building the first modern CPG company. We’ve created a new model—and home—for brands, founders, and talent looking to solve unmet needs, improve peoples’ lives, and ultimately challenge the status quo. Our Brands We are a growing portfolio of category leading brands. Our Story Mammoth Brands is the largest CPG company built in the last 20 years, and home to category leading brands - Harry’s, Flamingo, Lume, Mando, and Coterie. But, we didn’t start out that way… We started Harry’s to create a better shaving experience for guys like us.
